item.title: AI writes. Who vouches for it? The new axis of Software Engineering
item.description: A Harvard study of 655 firms shows that AI multiplies code but not delivery: the bottleneck moved to code review. What this changes for Software Engineering students at UnB — with the slide deck and infographic used in class.
